summary: Tests-only (red-phase) run for issue #39. Delivered: (1) the upstream solver parity corpus committed byte-identical (sha256 7b7b4d904ff369e1f5be0ec3a994d96cc996056e856d86a2b764b83c050f8604, from viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json, PR viamin/color_matching#112 = the issue's corpus dependency) as a test fixture, plus SolverParityCorpusTests replaying all 12 scenarios through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer AND CompositionSolver's fast path with exact (==) score/selection/tie assertions including the 5 intentional tie scenarios and 2 no-selection scenarios; (2) migration-pinning behavior tests for PaletteAPIClient (endpoints GET /api/v1/printer_profiles and GET /api/v1/colors?printer_profile_id=N, bearer token normalization/omission, 401/5xx/malformed error mapping, envelope decode) and OpenAPIContractTests pinning the /api/v1 wire shapes from the server's published OpenAPI schemas (viamin/color_matching#113 = the issue's spec dependency); (3) docs/parity-corpus.md recording corpus location/refresh and /api/v1 shape findings for the PR description. LIMITATION: this container has no Swift toolchain; bin/lint explicitly skips build/tests with exit 0 by design ('verify changes on a host with Swift installed'). swift test could NOT be executed here; the parity replay semantics were instead verified with an exact IEEE-754 double simulation (tmp/parity-replay-simulation.txt: 88 exact-agreement checks, 0 failures across all 12 scenarios). The generated-client implementation (swift-openapi-generator/runtime, Package.swift, OpenAPI document, README section) is intentionally out of scope for this tests-only phase and lands in the implementation run after paid-tests-approved.
